itens.titulo: CVE-2026-110447: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
itens.resumo: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

itens.titulo: CVE-2026-114625: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
itens.resumo: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.
